en.title: thedotmack/claude-mem: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent
en.summary: ⭐ 114,617 | Your coding agent forgets everything between sessions, forcing you to constantly repeat yourself. Claude-Mem solves this by running a **quiet observer** in the background that records activity, compresses it with AI, and automatically injects **vital project context** into your next session. It works seamlessly with Claude Code, Cursor, and over a dozen other developer tools.

zh.title: thedotmack/claude-mem：为每个AI编程助手带来跨会话的持久化记忆
zh.summary: ⭐ 114,617 | 你的AI编程助手每次重启就会失忆，让你不得不反复交代背景。Claude-Mem 在后台默默充当**隐形观察员**，记录并压缩工作内容，在下次对话时自动注入**核心项目上下文**。它完美支持 Claude Code、Cursor 以及十多种主流开发工具。

en.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
en.summary: Researchers have introduced ToyBlocks, an open simulation framework designed to help robots learn and test how to handle objects. By keeping the environment simple—a robot arm and blocks on a table—scientists can automatically generate training data and carefully measure **how models improve** or fail. This controlled setting makes it easier to figure out what works in **robot learning** before trying things out in the real world.

zh.title: ToyBlocks：一个用于机器人学习和评估的受控模拟世界
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了 ToyBlocks，这是一个旨在帮助机器人学习和测试物体操作的开源模拟框架。通过将环境简化为桌子上的机械臂和积木，科学家可以自动生成训练数据，并仔细衡量**模型如何改进**或失败。这种受控环境使得在现实世界中尝试之前，更容易弄清楚哪些方法在**机器人学习**中管用。

en.title: Worktrunk: A Git Worktree CLI Built for Parallel AI Agents
en.summary: ⭐ 11,991 | Worktrunk is a command-line tool designed to make Git worktrees as **easy as branches**, solving the traditional clunky user experience of managing multiple working directories. It is specifically built for running **parallel AI agents** like Claude Code or Codex, letting you effortlessly handle multiple tasks at once without interference.

zh.title: Worktrunk：专为并行 AI 助手设计的 Git 工作树管理工具
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,991 | Worktrunk 是一个命令行工具，旨在让 Git 工作树的**操作像分支一样简单**，彻底解决传统多工作目录管理繁琐的痛点。它专门为同时运行多个像 Claude Code 或 Codex 这样的 **AI 助手** 而设计，让你能轻松并发处理多项任务而互不干扰。

en.title: Capital Cools Down on World Models as Market Faces Reality
en.summary: Venture capital is pulling back from the **world model** sector, ending the earlier funding frenzy. While concept-driven startups struggle to raise money, investors are now tightening their purses and strictly backing **top-tier talents** with proven technical execution.

zh.title: 资本正在撤离“世界模型”，市场迎来现实降温
zh.summary: 曾经火热的“世界模型”赛道迎来了资本退潮，投资人不再盲目追逐概念。如今市场急剧降温，只有极少数具备**硬核技术**和明星背景的顶尖团队才能顺利拿到大钱。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), allowing users to **partition physical GPUs** into independent slices. This helps companies run multiple models on a single accelerator without resource contention, solving the problem of **under-utilized hardware** and reducing overall cloud inference costs.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker 现在支持多实例 GPU，大幅提升算力利用率
zh.summary: 亚马逊 SageMaker 推理服务现在支持英伟达多实例 GPU（MIG），允许用户把一个完整的物理 GPU **切分成多个独立小块**。这样一来，企业就能在一张显卡上同时运行多个 AI 模型，不仅能解决过去**硬件资源被白白浪费**的老大难问题，还能实实在在地降低云端运行成本。

en.title: Can startup founders still find a way out in Personal Agents?
en.summary: While big tech companies dominate general AI, **Personal Agents** offer startups a unique chance to build value beyond underlying models. By focusing on deep user context and specific vertical scenarios, startups can **break the mold** and avoid becoming mere token resellers, though they still face massive cost and infrastructure challenges.

zh.title: 创业者做个人AI助手，到底还有没有活路？
zh.summary: 虽然大厂在通用AI上占尽优势，但**个人AI助手**给创业者提供了一条把核心价值留在模型之外的新路。通过深耕垂直场景和用户关系，创业团队有机会**打破壳子**，不沦为大模型的打工仔，不过他们也得直面高昂的成本和技术挑战。

en.title: GitHub, Google, and Siemens Share 15 Design Patterns for AI Agents
en.summary: GitHub, Google, and Siemens have pooled their expertise to outline **15 design patterns** for building reliable AI agent systems. These patterns tackle common hurdles like **structured data exchange** and error recovery, helping developers make multi-agent systems more practical and dependable.

zh.title: GitHub、谷歌与西门子联合整理：AI智能体设计的15种核心模式
zh.summary: GitHub、谷歌和西门子联合梳理了**15种设计模式**，专门用来解决AI智能体开发中的实际痛点。这些模式覆盖了**结构化数据**交互和错误恢复等关键环节，能帮开发者打造出更靠谱、更好用的多智能体系统。

en.title: UK Public Bodies Swamped by AI-Generated Complaints
en.summary: UK public bodies and businesses are facing a massive surge in **chatbot-generated** complaints and legal challenges, a phenomenon known as 'AI clog'. While AI tools empower citizens to write formal letters easily, they create **enormous workloads** for human employees who must read and respond to much longer, sometimes inaccurate messages.

zh.title: 英国公共机构被人工智能生成的投诉信淹没
zh.summary: 英国的公共机构和企业正面临着一波由聊天机器人生成的投诉和法律挑战浪潮，这一现象被称为“AI堵塞”。虽然AI工具让普通人能轻松写出正式信件，但也给需要阅读和回复这些冗长甚至包含错误信息的人类员工带来了**沉重的工作负担**。

en.title: Silicon Valley Chinese Team Beats DeepSeek to Launch Next-Gen Agent Harness
en.summary: DeepSeek recently proposed a Super-agent concept to solve human attention bottlenecks, but a Silicon Valley Chinese team named AFK AI already put a similar multi-worker architecture into their open-source product Comma months ago. By using a single router to manage multiple background workers, the system lets users handle complex, multi-task workflows through a single conversational interface while keeping long-term memory intact.

zh.title: 抢跑DeepSeek！硅谷华人团队造出下一代超级智能体架构
zh.summary: DeepSeek最近提出了超级智能体理念来解决人类注意力不够用的问题，而一家硅谷华人团队AFK AI几个月前就把类似的架构做进了开源产品Comma里。它通过一个主脑统筹多个后台干活的AI，让用户只用面对一个对话框就能同时搞定各种复杂任务，还能记住历史经验。

en.title: Harness-S: Training Smarter AI Agents Using Sibling Execution Environments
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **Harness-S**, a clever training method that helps AI agents learn from their mistakes using a pool of alternative testing environments called sibling harnesses. When an AI fails in its primary environment, it tries out these backup environments, and the **successful rescue strategies** are baked back into the main AI policy. This approach significantly boosts performance on tough coding and task benchmarks like AppWorld and SWE-Gym.

zh.title: Harness-S：利用“兄弟环境”来训练更聪明的AI智能体
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了一种名为 **Harness-S** 的新型训练方法，通过建立一个“兄弟测试环境”池来帮AI智能体更好地吸取教训。当AI在默认环境下任务失败时，系统会把它转到其他辅助环境里继续尝试，并将这些**成功救场的经验**重新灌输回AI的大脑中。测试表明，这种方法能大幅提升AI在编程和各种复杂任务中的表现。

en.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
en.summary: One year after open-sourcing its wireless software, **NVIDIA's developer adoption** has grown 10x, with downloads exceeding 1 million. Researchers worldwide are using these tools to build **AI-native 6G networks** that improve robot response times, signal reception, and energy efficiency.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具助力研究人员打造下一代6G网络
zh.summary: 在英伟达开源无线软件一年后，其**开发者采用率**增长了十倍，下载量突破百万。全球研究人员正利用这些工具构建**人工智能原生6G网络**，以提升机器人响应速度、信号接收能力和能源效率。

en.title: Midterm elections deal a blow to data centers and Elon Musk
en.summary: Recent midterm elections saw voters and politicians push back hard against **data centers**, creating major roadblocks for tech companies. Elon Musk also found himself with little return after massive political donations, while AI giants like **OpenAI** are suddenly changing their secretive policies under mounting public pressure.

zh.title: 美国中期选举重挫数据中心建设，马斯克政治投资打水漂
zh.summary: 近期美国中期选举中，选民和新当选政客对**数据中心**展开强力抵制，给科技公司带来了不小的麻烦。马斯克砸了巨资却竹篮打水一场空，而面对日益高涨的公众压力，像**OpenAI**这样的AI巨头也开始急忙调整以往遮遮掩掩的政策。

en.title: Nasdaq crashes as AI bubble faces reality check over regulation and costs
en.summary: The Nasdaq suffered its worst session in months, wiping out over **$2.5 trillion** in market value as fears grew over the bursting of the AI speculative bubble. The drop was triggered by concerns over stricter **AI regulations** following the US midterm elections and growing local opposition to the heavy electricity and water use of data centers.

zh.title: 纳斯达克遭遇重挫，AI泡沫因监管和成本问题面临现实考验
zh.summary: 纳斯达克遭遇了数月来最惨的一天，蒸发了超过 **2.5万亿美元** 的市值，人们对人工智能投机泡沫破裂的担忧再度加剧。这次暴跌的导火索是美国中期选举后可能收紧的 **AI监管**，以及地方上对数据中心耗电耗水越来越多的反对声音。

en.title: NYT Cooking AI assistant is a handy kitchen helper, but keep an eye on it
en.summary: NYT Cooking has added an AI assistant that helps you swap ingredients, scale recipes, and handle missing equipment right inside the app. While it gives **smart suggestions** and saves you from digging through hundreds of comments, it's not foolproof. As the reviewer found out when baking a cake, you still need to **double-check measurements** so the AI doesn't mess up your food.

zh.title: 纽约时报烹饪AI助手挺实用，但盯着点儿免得翻车
zh.summary: 纽约时报烹饪应用最近上线了一个AI助手，能直接在应用里帮大家替换食材、调整分量以及应对缺少的厨具。虽然它能给出**聪明的建议**，省去了翻看几百条评论的麻烦，但它也不是百分之百完美。正如作者在烤蛋糕时发现的那样，你还是得**仔细核对用量**，免得AI把你的饭菜搞砸。
